articles.title: Azamgarh Shock: Bank Employee Caught Urinating on Unconscious Man’s Face, Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing video from Uttar Pradesh’s Azamgarh district has gone viral, showing a man urinating on another person’s face. The shocking clip has sparked massive outrage online, raising questions about eroding moral values in society.

body.html:
A disturbing video from Uttar Pradesh’s Azamgarh district has gone viral, showing a man urinating on another person’s face. The shocking clip has sparked massive outrage online, raising questions about eroding moral values in society.

The 15-second video, reportedly filmed in the Raedopur area of Azamgarh city, shows the accused committing the act while a stray dog appears in the background, visibly unsettled. Many users remarked that “animals often show more humanity than humans.”

Police have identified the accused as Sahil Kumar, a resident of Raedopur near the LIC building. Officials said Sahil is educated and works at a bank in Mau district. The victim’s identity is yet to be confirmed.

Circle Officer (City) Shubham Todi stated, “Based on video evidence and local inquiries, the accused Sahil Kumar has been taken into custody. Legal action will follow as per the law.”

The incident has left locals outraged, with several demanding strict punishment to set an example and prevent such inhumane behaviour in future.

articles.title: Man Slaps Woman Outside Her Home — Victim Had Earlier Attempted Suicide Over Harassment
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of harassment has come to light from the Refinery police station area in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, where a man identified as Harsh Saraswat allegedly slapped a young woman outside her house while she was chatting with her sister.

body.html:
A shocking case of harassment has come to light from the Refinery police station area in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, where a man identified as Harsh Saraswat allegedly slapped a young woman outside her house while she was chatting with her sister.

According to reports, the accused approached the sisters from behind and suddenly slapped one of them. The victim had earlier attempted suicide, reportedly due to the continuous harassment and intimidation by Harsh Saraswat, described by locals as a domineering and threatening man.

Following outrage on social media after the video surfaced, Mathura Police issued a statement saying: “the Station House Officer of Refinery Police Station has been directed to investigate the matter and take necessary legal action.”

Locals say the victim’s family had previously complained about the man’s behaviour, but no strict action was taken. The latest incident has once again raised concerns over women’s safety and police response to harassment complaints in Uttar Pradesh.

articles.title: “Disgusting! Man Caught Spitting on Rotis at UP Wedding — Video From Bulandshahr Sparks Outrage!”
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has surfaced from Aterna village in Bulandshahr district, Uttar Pradesh, where a man identified as Danish was allegedly caught spitting on rotis while preparing food at a wedding ceremony.

body.html:
A shocking incident has surfaced from Aterna village in Bulandshahr district, Uttar Pradesh, where a man identified as Danish was allegedly caught spitting on rotis while preparing food at a wedding ceremony.

In a 28-second viral video, Danish can be seen spitting three times on three rotis as he prepares them for guests. The shocking visuals have triggered public anger and disgust on social media.

According to reports, the incident occurred during the wedding of a daughter. Locals present at the venue noticed Danish’s act, caught him red-handed, and handed him over to the police.

Confirming the incident, Bulandshahr Police stated:

“A video of a young man making roti by spitting during a wedding ceremony under the Pahasu police station area has gone viral. Taking cognizance, a case has been registered against the accused, and further action is being taken.”

Deputy Superintendent of Police (Rural) Dr. Tejvir Singh said that the accused has been taken into custody and will be sent to jail following due legal process.

The disturbing act has reignited public debate over food hygiene and religious sentiments, with many demanding strict punishment for such behaviour.

body.html:
A street fight in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, has gone viral after social media personalities Mehak and Pari, known for their controversial videos, were seen brawling with a rickshaw driver in broad daylight.

According to reports, the altercation began when the Mehak-Pari sisters confronted a rickshaw driver, allegedly over harassment. The situation quickly escalated as both sisters teamed up to attack the driver. In retaliation, the rickshaw driver fought back and thrashed both women, as onlookers recorded the entire scene on video.

The viral footage has reignited discussions around the sisters, who were previously arrested by Sambhal Police for producing obscene videos. Following their release, they had reportedly stopped such activities — until this latest controversy.

After the video went viral, Mehak Pari defended her actions, saying, “The rickshaw driver was harassing us thinking we were ordinary girls. We gave him a taste of his own medicine.”

Meanwhile, police confirmed that an FIR in connection with obscene content involving the sisters had already been filed earlier. Authorities are now looking into the latest incident as well.

Observers online have mocked the sisters, saying that even a stint in jail hasn’t changed their behaviour, as the duo continues to court controversy.

articles.title: Lawless UP? Traffic Cop Beaten in Broad Daylight for Stopping Wrong-Side Car
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of lawlessness in Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, has surfaced after a traffic policeman was brutally assaulted by a group of youths for simply doing his duty.

body.html:
A shocking case of lawlessness in Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh, has surfaced after a traffic policeman was brutally assaulted by a group of youths for simply doing his duty. The incident took place on Sunday near Chandra Cinema in the Nagar Kotwali area, when a Delhi-registered Ertiga car was caught driving on the wrong side, causing a major traffic jam.

When Traffic Constable Jamin Ali tried to stop the vehicle and clear the congestion, two men and a minor allegedly got out of the car and attacked him, tearing his uniform in the scuffle.
The entire assault was caught on camera, and the video has since gone viral on social media, sparking outrage over the growing impunity and public indiscipline in the state.

Eyewitnesses said the officer was beaten mercilessly in full public view while trying to enforce traffic rules.

Following the incident, Muzaffarnagar Police issued a statement saying:
“A case has been registered against the accused under stringent sections by the Kotwali Police Station. Two teams have been formed for their early arrest, and further legal action is underway.”

The shocking attack has reignited debates over rising aggression against police personnel and the declining respect for law enforcement in Uttar Pradesh, even as the state government continues to project its “law and order model” elsewhere.
